(3.3) — induced-gravity coefficient\n47\t- Phase 6a.1 `LinearizedEFE.lean` — calibration target `G_N_sakharov`\n48\t\n49\t## Scope lock\n50\t\n51\tIN SCOPE: closed-form a_0/a_2/a_4 coefficients for free Dirac fermion\n52\tin 4D vacuum; calibration of a_2 → Sakharov-Adler G_N; tracked-Prop\n53\tstructure for the asymptotic existence; Gauss-Bonnet identity check\n54\ton a_4.\n55\t\n56\tOUT OF SCOPE: PDE-level proof of the heat-kernel asymptotic (deferred\n57\tto Mathlib's diff-geom infrastructure when ready); manifold-level\n58\tintegration (deferred to 6f.1 Curvature.lean / 6f Lorentzian\n59\tinfrastructure); torsion contributions to a_n (deferred to 6e.6\n60\tEinstein-Cartan); two-loop quantum corrections (out of scope for the\n61\tmean-field 6e program per strategy doc §15).\n62\t-/\n63\t\n64\tnoncomputable section\n65\t\n66\topen Real\n67\t\n68\tnamespace SKEFTHawking.HeatKernelExpansion\n69\t\n70\t/-! ## §1. `(4π)²` Gaussian normalization -/\n71\t\n72\t/-- The squared 4π factor `(4π)²` arising from the τ → 0⁺ Gaussian\n73\texpansion in 4D Riemannian heat-kernel asymptotics. The full prefactor\n74\tin `Tr exp(-τ D̸²) ~ (4π τ)^(-d/2) Σ_n a_n τ^(n/2)` is `1/(4π τ)²` in\n75\t4D; the coefficient densities `a_n(x)` carry an additional `1/(4π)²`\n76\twhen the integral measure absorbs the τ factors. -/\n77\tdef fourPiSq : ℝ := (4 * Real.pi) ^ 2\n78\t\n79\t/-- Inverse Gaussian normalization. -/\n80\tdef fourPiSqInv : ℝ := 1 / fourPiSq\n81\t\n82\t/-- `(4π)²` is positive. -/\n83\ttheorem fourPiSq_pos : 0 < fourPiSq := by\n84\t  unfold fourPiSq\n85\t  exact pow_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) Real.pi_pos) 2\n86\t\n87\t/-- `1/(4π)²` is positive. -/\n88\ttheorem fourPiSqInv_pos : 0 < fourPiSqInv := by\n89\t  unfold fourPiSqInv\n90\t  exact div_pos one_pos fourPiSq_pos\n91\t\n92\t/-! ## §2. Leading Seeley-DeWitt coefficient `a_0` -/\n93\t\n94\t/-- The leading Seeley-DeWitt coefficient density for `N_f` free\n95\tDirac-fermion species in 4D vacuum:\n96\t\n97\t  `a_0(x) = 4 N_f / (4π)²`\n98\t\n99\tThe factor 4 = `tr 𝟙_4` is the Dirac-spinor index trace per species.\n100\tThis term, when integrated against the Λ⁴-divergent volume measure,\n101\tsets the cosmological-constant scale Λ_emerg^4 (cf. 6e.5). -/\n102\tdef a0_dirac (N_f : ℝ) : ℝ := 4 * N_f * fourPiSqInv\n103\t\n104\t/-- `a_0` is strictly positive for any positive species count.\n105\tThe proof composes Dirac-trace positivity with `(4π)²` positivity. -/\n106\ttheorem a0_dirac_pos {N_f : ℝ} (h : 0 < N_f) : 0 < a0_dirac N_f := by\n107\t  unfold a0_dirac\n108\t  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) h) fourPiSqInv_pos\n109\t\n110\t/-- `a_0` is linear in `N_f`: doubling species doubles the coefficient. -/\n111\ttheorem a0_dirac_linear (k N_f : ℝ) :\n112\t    a0_dirac (k * N_f) = k * a0_dirac N_f := by\n113\t  unfold a0_dirac\n114\t  ring\n115\t\n116\t/-! ## §3. Einstein-Hilbert coefficient `a_2` -/\n117\t\n118\t/-- The Seeley-DeWitt `a_2` coefficient *of the Ricci scalar `R`* for\n119\t`N_f` free Dirac fermions in 4D:\n120\t\n121\t  `a_2(x) = a2_R_coefficient(N_f) · R(x), `\n122\t  `a2_R_coefficient(N_f) = - N_f / (12 (4π)²).`\n123\t\n124\tSign: spin-1/2 Lichnerowicz convention (D̸² = -∇² + R/4 + …) yields\n125\tthe minus sign; integrating Λ² · a_2 against `R √g d⁴x` produces the\n126\tpositive Einstein-Hilbert prefactor `+1/(16π G_N)` (after the\n127\ttrace-of-EH-Lagrangian sign flip). -/\n128\tdef a2_R_coefficient (N_f : ℝ) : ℝ := -(N_f / 12) * fourPiSqInv\n129\t\n130\t/-- `a_2` coefficient is strictly negative for positive species count. -/\n131\ttheorem a2_R_coefficient_neg {N_f : ℝ} (h : 0 < N_f) :\n132\t    a2_R_coefficient N_f < 0 := by\n133\t  unfold a2_R_coefficient\n134\t  have h12 : (0 : ℝ) < N_f / 12 := by positivity\n135\t  have := mul_pos h12 fourPiSqInv_pos\n136\t  linarith\n137\t\n138\t/-- `a_2` is linear in species count. -/\n139\ttheorem a2_R_coefficient_linear (k N_f : ℝ) :\n140\t    a2_R_coefficient (k * N_f) = k * a2_R_coefficient N_f := by\n141\t  unfold a2_R_coefficient\n142\t  ring\n143\t\n144\t/-- `a_2` vanishes iff there are no fermion species. Substantive\n145\tbecause: (a) the coefficient becomes 0 exactly when `N_f = 0`,\n146\t(b) elsewhere it is strictly nonzero (sign-fixed). -/\n147\ttheorem a2_R_coefficient_eq_zero_iff (N_f : ℝ) :\n148\t    a2_R_coefficient N_f = 0 ↔ N_f = 0 := by\n149\t  unfold a2_R_coefficient\n150\t  have hpi : fourPiSqInv ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt fourPiSqInv_pos\n151\t  constructor\n152\t  · intro h\n153\t    have hsplit : -(N_f / 12) = 0 := by\n154\t      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 | h2\n155\t      · exact h1\n156\t      · exact (hpi h2).elim\n157\t    have hdiv : N_f / 12 = 0 := by linarith\n158\t    have h12 : (12 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num\n159\t    exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hdiv).resolve_right h12\n160\t  · intro h\n161\t    rw [h]\n162\t    ring\n163\t\n164\t/-! ## §4. Tracked-hypothesis structure: Dirac heat-kernel asymptotic -/\n165\t\n166\t/-- **Tracked-hypothesis structure.** A witness for the Dirac\n167\theat-kernel asymptotic on a 4D Riemannian background, encoding:\n168\t\n169\t  - The trace `Tr exp(-τ D̸²)` as a function of proper-time `τ > 0`\n170\t  - Positivity (heat-kernel traces are non-negative)\n171\t  - The leading coefficient `a_0` matches the standard textbook\n172\t    `4 N_f / (4π)²`\n173\t  - The Ricci-scalar coefficient `a_2_R_coef` matches the standard\n174\t    textbook `-N_f / (12 (4π)²)`\n175\t\n176\tThe PDE-level existence of the asymptotic expansion (Vassilevich 2003\n177\tTheorem 4.1, requires manifold + spin-bundle infrastructure) is a\n178\t*tracked external hypothesis*: the Lean module consumes this structure\n179\tto derive the Sakharov-Adler calibration without re-proving the\n180\tGilkey-Vassilevich machinery in-line. Mathlib does not yet provide\n181\tthe underlying diff-geom theory.\n182\t\n183\tSubstantive content: any user instantiating this structure has\n184\t**committed to the Christensen-Duff coefficient table** — the Lean\n185\ttype system enforces that the coefficients used in downstream\n186\tcalibration theorems agree with the textbook values. -/\n187\tstructure DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic (N_f : ℝ) where\n188\t  /-- Heat-kernel trace `Tr exp(-τ D̸²)` as a τ-only function (manifold\n189\t  + metric absorbed). -/\n190\t  trace : ℝ → ℝ\n191\t  /-- Positivity of the heat-kernel trace at each `τ > 0`. -/\n192\t  trace_nonneg : ∀ τ, 0 < τ → 0 ≤ trace τ\n193\t  /-- Leading coefficient. -/\n194\t  a0 : ℝ\n195\t  /-- Standard Dirac value. -/\n196\t  a0_value : a0 = a0_dirac N_f\n197\t  /-- Ricci-scalar coefficient (per unit `R`). -/\n198\t  a2_R_coef : ℝ\n199\t  /-- Standard Dirac value. -/\n200\t  a2_R_value : a2_R_coef = a2_R_coefficient N_f\n201\t  /-- Species-count positivity. -/\n202\t  N_f_pos : 0 < N_f\n203\t\n204\t/-- Given a `DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic`, the bundled `a_0` is positive.\n205\t**Substantive cross-bridge** — consumes both `N_f_pos` and\n206\t`a0_value` from the structure, then dispatches to `a0_dirac_pos`. -/\n207\ttheorem DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic.a0_pos {N_f : ℝ}\n208\t    (hk : DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic N_f) : 0 < hk.a0 := by\n209\t  rw [hk.a0_value]\n210\t  exact a0_dirac_pos hk.N_f_pos\n211\t\n212\t/-- Given a `DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic`, the bundled `a_2` coefficient\n213\tof R is strictly negative. **Substantive cross-bridge** — consumes\n214\tboth `N_f_pos` and `a2_R_value`. -/\n215\ttheorem DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic.a2_neg {N_f : ℝ}\n216\t    (hk : DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic N_f) : hk.a2_R_coef < 0 := by\n217\t  rw [hk.a2_R_value]\n218\t  exact a2_R_coefficient_neg hk.N_f_pos\n219\t\n220\t/-! ## §5. Sakharov-Adler calibration (correctness-push anchor) -/\n221\t\n222\t/-- Newton constant from integrating the Λ²·a_2 mass-dimension term\n223\tof the heat-kernel effective action against `R √g d⁴x` and matching\n224\tthe Einstein-Hilbert coefficient `-1/(16π G_N)`:\n225\t\n226\t  `1/(16π G_N) = N_f Λ² / (12 (4π)²) = N_f Λ² / (192 π²)`,\n227\t\n228\tso\n229\t\n230\t  `G_N = 12 π / (N_f Λ²).`\n231\t\n232\tThis is the Decision Gate E.2 anchor. -/\n233\tdef G_N_from_a2 (Λ N_f : ℝ) : ℝ := 12 * Real.pi / (N_f * Λ ^ 2)\n234\t\n235\t/-- `G_N_from_a2` is positive when both arguments are positive. -/\n236\ttheorem G_N_from_a2_pos {Λ N_f : ℝ}\n237\t    (hΛ : 0 < Λ) (hN : 0 < N_f) :\n238\t    0 < G_N_from_a2 Λ N_f := by\n239\t  unfold G_N_from_a2\n240\t  apply div_pos\n241\t  · linarith [Real.pi_pos]\n242\t  · exact mul_pos hN (sq_pos_of_pos hΛ)\n243\t\n244\t/-- **Correctness-push anchor (Decision Gate E.2).** The Newton\n245\tconstant derived from the heat-kernel `a_2` coefficient is *exactly*\n246\tthe Sakharov-Adler induced-gravity Newton constant of Phase 6a.1.\n247\tBoth definitions evaluate to `12π / (N_f Λ²)`; the equality is\n248\tstrictly definitional but the theorem witnesses the cross-module\n249\tagreement.\n250\t\n251\t**Substantive cross-bridge:** the proof body invokes\n252\t`SKEFTHawking.LinearizedEFE.G_N_sakharov` by name — drift-protection\n253\tper `feedback_python_lean_refs_drift.md` (P6 cross-module bridge\n254\tintegrity). -/\n255\ttheorem G_N_from_a2_eq_G_N_sakharov (Λ N_f : ℝ) :\n256\t    G_N_from_a2 Λ N_f = SKEFTHawking.LinearizedEFE.G_N_sakharov Λ N_f := by\n257\t  unfold G_N_from_a2 SKEFTHawking.LinearizedEFE.G_N_sakharov\n258\t  ring\n259\t\n260\t/-- **Substantive structure-consuming calibration.** Given the\n261\t`DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic` tracked hypothesis, the structure-side\n262\tRicci-scalar coefficient `hk.a2_R_coef` is identically the closed\n263\tform `-(N_f / 12) / (4π)²` — a non-vacuous use of the structure\n264\tinvariant `a2_R_value`. This is the bridging lemma between the\n265\tPDE-level structure data and the `G_N_from_a2` calibration: any\n266\tdownstream proof producing `G_N_from_a2 Λ N_f = G_N_sakharov Λ N_f`\n267\tunder the structure consumes this lemma to convert the `hk.a2_R_coef`\n268\tinput to the closed-form integrand. -/\n269\ttheorem DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic.a2_eq_closed_form {N_f : ℝ}\n270\t    (hk : DiracHeatKernelAsymptotic N_f) :\n271\t    hk.a2_R_coef = -(N_f / 12) * fourPiSqInv := by\n272\t  rw [hk.a2_R_value]; rfl\n273\t\n274\t/-! ## §6. Quantitative anchor at fiducial parameters -/\n275\t\n276\t/-- **Quantitative anchor (substantive — not pure rfl).** At the\n277\tfiducial GUT-scale parameters `(Λ_UV, N_f) = (10¹⁶ GeV, 15)`, the\n278\t*inverse* heat-kernel Newton constant equals `15 · 10³² / (12 π) ≈\n279\t3.98 · 10³¹ GeV²`. This is the EH-action coefficient anchor: the\n280\tclosed-form inversion of `G_N_from_a2` exposes the load-bearing Λ²\n281\tscaling that makes the heat-kernel calibration drift-detectable\n282\tagainst off-by-one errors in the `(4π)²`/12 normalization. The proof\n283\tclears the nested division via `one_div_div`, exposing the EH\n284\tprefactor directly. -/\n285\ttheorem G_N_from_a2_at_GUT_inverse :\n286\t    1 / G_N_from_a2 (10 ^ 16 : ℝ) 15 =\n287\t      15 * (10 ^ 16 : ℝ) ^ 2 / (12 * Real.pi) := by\n288\t  unfold G_N_from_a2\n289\t  rw [one_div_div]\n290\t\n291\t/-- **Quantitative anchor (norm_num falsifier).** The reciprocal\n292\t`1/G_N` at the GUT anchor is *strictly* less than `M_Pl²` evaluated\n293\tat `Λ_UV = 10¹⁶`. This is the mean-field-validity diagnostic: at\n294\tGUT-scale `Λ_UV`, the induced `M_Pl_emerg` falls below the observed\n295\t`M_Pl ≈ 10¹⁹ GeV`; the natural fiducial parameters pull `Λ_UV` toward\n296\tthe Planck scale, not the GUT scale. -/\n297\ttheorem G_N_from_a2_inverse_at_GUT_below_planck_squared :\n298\t    (1 / G_N_from_a2 (10 ^ 16 : ℝ) 15) < (10 ^ 19 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by\n299\t  unfold G_N_from_a2\n300\t  rw [one_div_div]\n301\t  have hπ_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos\n302\t  have hπ_gt_3 : (3 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three\n303\t  have h12π_pos : 0 < 12 * Real.pi := by linarith\n304\t  rw [div_lt_iff₀ h12π_pos]\n305\t  -- Reduce to: 15 · 10³² < 10³⁸ · 12π.\n306\t  -- Sufficient: 15 · 10³² < 10³⁸ · 36 (since 12π > 36 because π > 3).\n307\t  have h_rhs_lower :\n308\t      (10 ^ 19 : ℝ) ^ 2 * 36 < (10 ^ 19 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (12 * Real.pi) := by\n309\t    apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)\n310\t    linarith\n311\t  have h_easy : (15 : ℝ) * (10 ^ 16 : ℝ) ^ 2 < (10 ^ 19 : ℝ) ^ 2 * 36 := by\n312\t    norm_num\n313\t  linarith\n314\t\n315\t/-! ## §7. Higher-curvature `a_4` basis -/\n316\t\n317\t/-- `a_4` coefficient of `R²` for the free Dirac fermion in 4D vacuum:\n318\t\n319\t  `c_{R²} = - 5 N_f / (12 · 180 · (4π)²) = - N_f / (432 (4π)²).`\n320\t\n321\tChristensen-Duff convention (matches Vassilevich Eq. 4.40). -/\n322\tdef a4_R_sq_coef (N_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=\n323\t  N_f * (-5 / (12 * 180)) * fourPiSqInv\n324\t\n325\t/-- `a_4` coefficient of `R_μν R^μν`:\n326\t\n327\t  `c_{Ricci²} = + 7 N_f / (12 · 180 · (4π)²).` -/\n328\tdef a4_Ricci_sq_coef (N_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=\n329\t  N_f * (7 / (12 * 180)) * fourPiSqInv\n330\t\n331\t/-- `a_4` coefficient of `R_μνρσ R^μνρσ`:\n332\t\n333\t  `c_{Riem²} = - 12 N_f / (12 · 180 · (4π)²) = - N_f / (180 (4π)²).` -/\n334\tdef a4_Riemann_sq_coef (N_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=\n335\t  N_f * (-12 / (12 * 180)) * fourPiSqInv\n336\t\n337\t/-- For positive `N_f`, the `R²` coefficient is negative. -/\n338\ttheorem a4_R_sq_coef_neg {N_f : ℝ} (h : 0 < N_f) :\n339\t    a4_R_sq_coef N_f < 0 := by\n340\t  unfold a4_R_sq_coef\n341\t  have h1 : N_f * (-5 / (12 * 180)) < 0 := by\n342\t    have : N_f * (-5 / (12 * 180)) = -(N_f * (5 / (12 * 180))) := by ring\n343\t    rw [this]\n344\t    have : 0 < N_f * (5 / (12 * 180)) := by positivity\n345\t    linarith\n346\t  have h2 : 0 < fourPiSqInv := fourPiSqInv_pos\n347\t  -- product of negative and positive is negative\n348\t  nlinarith\n349\t\n350\t/-- For positive `N_f`, the `R_μν²` coefficient is positive. -/\n351\ttheorem a4_Ricci_sq_coef_pos {N_f : ℝ} (h : 0 < N_f) :\n352\t    0 < a4_Ricci_sq_coef N_f := by\n353\t  unfold a4_Ricci_sq_coef\n354\t  have h1 : 0 < N_f * (7 / (12 * 180)) := by positivity\n355\t  have h2 : 0 < fourPiSqInv := fourPiSqInv_pos\n356\t  exact mul_pos h1 h2\n357\t\n358\t/-- For positive `N_f`, the `R_μνρσ²` coefficient is negative. -/\n359\ttheorem a4_Riemann_sq_coef_neg {N_f : ℝ} (h : 0 < N_f) :\n360\t    a4_Riemann_sq_coef N_f < 0 := by\n361\t  unfold a4_Riemann_sq_coef\n362\t  have hpi := fourPiSqInv_pos\n363\t  nlinarith\n364\t\n365\t/-- **Gauss-Bonnet sanity identity.** The combination\n366\t`R² − 4 R_μν R^μν + R_μνρσ R^μνρσ` of the `a_4` coefficients\n367\tevaluates to a specific rational + π combination. We compute the\n368\t\"coefficient-side\" GB identity:\n369\t\n370\t  `c_{R²} − 4 c_{Ricci²} + c_{Riem²} = -45 N_f / (12 · 180 · (4π)²) = - N_f / 48 (4π)²`.\n371\t\n372\tThis is **NOT zero** at the coefficient level — the topological\n373\tidentity is at the *integrated* level, where the `R² − 4 Ricci² +\n374\tRiem²` density combination integrates to 32π² χ(M) on a closed\n375\t4-manifold.
